title: MoonFall Final Mission - Canonical Values & Simulation Model
document_reference: MoonFall: Final Mission Game Logic (Team ChandraPath, NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026)

physical_units.O2: 0.135 kg O2 per point (NASA BVAD, 0.895 kg/person/day)
physical_units.Food: 3.6 kg per point (30 days food for 5 crew)

A Evacuate.gain: Crew is inside before the storm (short rover drive, ~10 mSv).
A Evacuate.cost: Outside power gear is left switched on and gets damaged (-12).

B Secure Equip.gain: Outside gear is shut down safely (only -2).
B Secure Equip.cost: Crew stays out ~20 min longer in suits (-5 = ~50 mSv); rover and shutdown use 4 kWh.

A Deep Shelter.gain: Cheapest option: shelter fans (-1); no outside work, no hardware wear.

B Pile Regolith.gain: Best protection: only ~15 mSv gets through (-1).
B Pile Regolith.cost: Rover pushes regolith into place (8 kWh); abrasive dust wears seals (-8).

C Water Shield.gain: Good protection (~30 mSv, -3) with no hardware wear.
C Water Shield.cost: 100 kg water pumped into bladders (-20 water, -2 power).

A Greenhouse Off.gain: Lowest battery use (-10): only life support runs.
A Greenhouse Off.cost: Crops get no light or heat (-20).

B Backup Power.gain: Everything stays on; crops are not hurt.
B Backup Power.cost: Deep battery discharge shortens hardware life (-15 power, -8 equip).

C Brownout All.gain: Middle path: crops keep half their light (only -8).
C Brownout All.cost: Cabin cools to ~18 deg C; crew sleeps poorly (-2 health, -13 power).

A Bottled O2.gain: Fastest and safest immediate cabin air.
A Bottled O2.cost: Uses emergency reserve O2 (-3) and hardware wear (-8).

B Electrolysis.cost: High electrical power draw (-14 kWh) and water consumption (-1).

A Stored Potable.gain: No power used; primary filters rest and recover (+3).
A Stored Potable.cost: Draws 50 kg of potable reserves (-10 water).

B Melt Crater Ice.cost: Thermal heating takes 15 kWh (-15 power) and sediment wear (-5 equip).

C Drink Priority.gain: Crew hydration safeguarded at minimal draw (-3 water).
C Drink Priority.cost: Greenhouse irrigation suspended for the day (-10 crop condition).

A Restore Loop.gain: Crops recover (+10) and next harvest secured (+6 food).
A Restore Loop.cost: Pumps and grow lights consume 12 kWh (-12) and 30 kg water (-6).

B Abandon Crops.gain: Power shed from greenhouse returned to base reserves (+8).
B Abandon Crops.cost: Crop failure (-35 greenhouse, -8 food harvest lost).

A Isolate Bus.cost: Module 4 offline until full replacement (-12 equip).

B Manual Repair.gain: Junction rebuilt and restored to full integrity (+10 equip).
B Manual Repair.cost: High stress repairs consume 10 kWh (-10) and hazardous work (-4 health).

C Reroute Bus.gain: Module remains powered with minimal hardware wear (-3).
C Reroute Bus.cost: Sub-optimal resistance heats lines (-8 power) and greenhouse cut (-8).

A Hold Shelter.gain: Crew rests protected from tail radiation (+3 health).
A Hold Shelter.cost: Extended life support consumption (-2 water, -6 battery power).

B Controlled Recovery.gain: Inverters reactivated; solar generation restored (+15 power, +6 equip).
B Controlled Recovery.cost: Residual particle exposure during outside EVA (-5 health).
